_comment: Example for Prime. Copy to %LOCALAPPDATA%\McCluster\production-executor.json (outside git) and set MCCLUSTER_PRODUCTION_CONFIG to it. Paths marked <...> must be filled in on the machine. unreal_projects is the owner's registry of approved Unreal projects and Level Sequences: a job names only these ids. tools/production/unreal/find-proven-render.ps1 prints the s31 entry from the project and logs that rendered the proof.

gib-s31-proof.uproject: <absolute path to the isolated project copy that rendered the proof>.uproject
